points.quote: A document is a Yjs `Doc`. The BlockSuite block tree lives inside it as Y.Maps.
Those updates go into local storage, and the frontend runs `applyUpdate(doc, update, NBSTORE_ORIGIN)`, so the editor changes without echoing the update back.
On disk and on the wire the data is binary Yjs updates, plus merged snapshots (`packages/common/nbstore/src/storage/doc.ts`).
The storage layer is `@affine/nbstore` (`packages/common/nbstore`). ... **Web (IndexedDB):** one database per workspace ... **Desktop (Electron) and mobile:** a SQLite file per workspace

AFFiNE stores each document as a Yjs CRDT, saves it locally as binary updates and snapshots, and syncs those updates with the server over a websocket. ... `sync/doc/peer.ts` runs one queue per remote peer
